title: Levels beyond the DAW's clip gain and fader ranges are kept, with a warning
description:
As a producer, I want levels beyond what the DAW's clip gain or fader allows to be kept, with a warning, so that the set's balance matches the render.

```gherkin
Feature: Levels beyond the DAW's ranges
  Scenario: A very quiet sample raised beyond the clip gain's range
    Given the sample "far.wav" needs a level match of +28 dB
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the export succeeds
    And the track playing "far.wav" makes up what its clips can't hold before its fader
    And the export warns with the track's name and the amount moved

  Scenario: A fader above the DAW's fader range
    Given the track "horn" has "volume 10"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the track "horn" is 10 dB louder than at 0 dB in the set
    And the export warns with the track's name

  Scenario: A long score with many notes
    Given a 64-bar score with a track playing sixteenth-note steps
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the track has 1024 clips
    And the export finishes in under 10 seconds
```

Note: the DAW's exact clip gain and fader ranges, and where the difference goes (a Utility device at the start or end of the track's chain), come from `design/daw-set.md` (M0).
